Greeting. About Myself. “My name is…” with grammar focus TO BE (positive + negative)

Professions. Grammar Focus: Present Simple (Positive Sentences)

Numbers 21–50 Plural nouns (books, pens. Grammar: Present Continuous – Questions & Negatives

Shopping phrases. Can I have…?/I would like…

On the phone 2. Present Continuous for actions now
